scope: Literal image filenames through list, cover, gallery and legacy skill rendering, real HTTP file requests and missing-image fallback

before.reproduction: Ran all 20 new cases against the pre-fix renderers and resolver. Twelve filename consistency cases, four literal fallback path cases and one missing generic cover case failed; two ordinary filename cases and the rejected-input compatibility case passed.

commands.after: node --test scripts/tests/image-display.test.mjs scripts/tests/media.test.mjs scripts/tests/structured-render.test.mjs scripts/tests/workspace-layout.test.mjs scripts/tests/export.test.mjs scripts/tests/editor-filtering.test.mjs

skipReason: Node/Rust archive interoperability requires VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY; native archive code unchanged
testEnvironment: Actual cover/helper functions and the production editor controller execute in DOM fixtures and request files from real local HTTP servers in temporary registered workspaces. The adapter changes only the ephemeral server port, preserving the renderer-generated URL path, query and fragment. Raw filename identity is checked by returned file contents against decoys. Missing-image events are explicitly invoked to exercise fallback progression; no image decoding is simulated. Source BOM/CRLF, asset bytes and registry records remain unchanged.
